title: Text: KC Alec Zumwalt ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Seems to me, a lot hinges on Hosmer. I’m 100% in on him - great player, getting better, will age well - but it would be nice to be able to sign another mid-to-upper tier FA to go with him.
